note: Rejudged 2026-09-30 (ike-eap judge). Sentence 1: Linux performs ESP-in-UDP, so the proof is the state Ze installs: TestRFC7296ESPInUDPStateHasESPRightAfterUDP asserts xfrmStateFromParams builds an encapsulated 4500/4500 SA with Encap.Type XFRM_ENCAP_ESPINUDP (the RFC 3948 form, ESP header right after UDP, not ESPINUDP_NON_IKE) and the SA's SPI. Sentence 2: TestRFC7296ESPInUDPStateRefusesSPIZero forces SPI 0 on an encapsulated SA and requires a refusal with no state; judge mutation (SPI==0 check disabled in xfrmStateFromParams) turned it red, so it is not vacuous. Both carry records. Receive-side distinction stays on transport TestNonESPMarker/TestNonESPMarkerESPPacket (recorded). No netns wire capture (needs root); the template Ze installs is the boundary Ze owns.
